_note: Slots for [brg_community-give]. The `slides` repeater was wired by conti 2026-09-23 at Sean's request — finn owns this file, same arrangement as team-members. Declared beside the fragment so a slot and its {{token}} ship in one commit. Generated into website/acf/ by `python3 kit/build-acf.py`; never hand-edit an acf.json. `text`/`textarea` defaults are esc_html'd on fill, so write literal characters — a literal `&` and a literal `—`, never `&` or `—`.\n\nTHE LEDE IS THREE SLOTS, NOT ONE, because it wraps an inline <b> and no field may carry HTML. The spaces either side of the <b> live in the markup on purpose: ACF trims on save, so a default ending in a space would lose it and the words would run together.

lede_1.label: Lede — before the emphasis
lede_1.doc: Opening clause, ending at the em dash. The space before the emphasized phrase is in the markup, so do not add a trailing space here. Write the em dash as a literal —.
lede_1.default: At BRG, community isn't a marketing initiative —

lede_emphasis.label: Lede — emphasized phrase
lede_emphasis.doc: Rendered in the display face, slightly larger, mid-sentence. Short — a clause, not a sentence.

lede_2.label: Lede — after the emphasis
lede_2.doc: The rest of the paragraph. The space after the emphasized phrase is in the markup, so start straight in with a capital.
lede_2.default: When our restaurants thrive, the people around us should feel that too. That means showing up at local events, supporting causes that matter, partnering with schools and nonprofits, and investing in the places our guests call home.

banner.label: Teal banner
banner.doc: The rotated teal band straddling the white intro and the dark slider. Sized to its content (width:max-content, capped at 92%) so length is forgiving, but it renders at up to 3rem — past ~28 characters it starts wrapping and the rotation reads badly.

slides.label: Slides
slides.doc: One row per slide, in the order they appear. Drag to reorder. Any number works: the slider builds its own dots, and the panel color alternates black / yellow by position, so adding or removing a slide re-colors the rest automatically — do not try to set a color per slide. Until the first row is added the page keeps the three slides it shows today.

photo.label: Photo
photo.doc: Fills the image half of the slide, cropped to fit, so the exact size does not matter. Portrait or landscape both work. A tall crop around 1200px on the long edge is plenty — bigger files only slow the page.

photo_tone.label: Photo — color
photo_tone.doc: Color is the default. Switch this photo to black and white when you want it that way on purpose — the photography on this site was only ever gray because the placeholder images were. Affects this photo alone.

photo_px.label: Photo — movement
photo_px.doc: How far this photo drifts inside its frame as you scroll, as a percentage of the frame's height. 0 is off. The dropdown this replaces offered 6, 10 and 16 as Subtle, Medium and Strong, so anything already set still reads exactly the same — you can now pick the values in between. 40 is the ceiling: the page itself stops there, so a larger number would do nothing. The photo is laid out taller than its frame and slides within it, so an edge never appears and it is never zoomed.

photo_px_dir.label: Photo — movement direction
photo_px_dir.doc: Which way this photo travels as the page scrolls. Neighboring photos set in opposite directions are what reads as depth.

photo_float.label: Photo — frame drift
photo_float.doc: Moves the whole frame across the section, on top of the movement inside it, as a percentage of the frame's height. 0 is off; 8 and 12 were the old Gentle and Strong. 40 is the ceiling. Leave this off for a photo that fills its section edge to edge — there is nothing behind it to reveal.

photo_float_dir.label: Photo — drift direction
photo_float_dir.doc: Which way this frame drifts. Set a large and a small photo in opposite directions.

title.label: Title
title.doc: Shown in the display face, uppercase. Short — around 24 characters keeps it on one line.

body.label: Text
body.doc: The paragraph under the title, capped at 44 characters wide. Around 200 characters sits best; much longer and the panel grows taller than the photo beside it.

cta_label.label: Button label
cta_label.doc: Optional. Leave blank and no button appears. Two or three words, e.g. 'Apply for a donation'.

cta_href.label: Button link
cta_href.doc: Where the button goes — a full https:// address, or a path on this site like /contact/. Ignored when the label is blank.

video_id.label: Background video (optional)
video_id.doc: Paste a YouTube or Vimeo link, or just the ID. Leave blank and the photo above is used. The video plays silently on a loop with no controls, and the photo shows while it loads, if the video is blocked, or for visitors who have switched off animation.

video_source.label: Video from
video_source.doc: Which service the link is from. Only matters when a video is set.

section_bg.label: Section background
section_bg.doc: A pattern or photo filling this whole section, behind everything else. Leave it empty — as it is now — and the section keeps the plain color it has today; nothing changes until you choose something. It is cropped to fill, so the exact size does not matter. ON A DARK SECTION USE A LIGHT OR GRAY ARTWORK: a black pattern over a black panel stays invisible however high you set the strength below.

section_bg_opacity.label: Background strength
section_bg_opacity.doc: How strongly the background shows through. Choose 100% when the artwork already has the intended strength built into the file — anything lower then fades a graphic that was supplied ready to use. Use the lower values when a full-strength image would compete with the words in front of it.

section_bg_px.label: Background movement
section_bg_px.doc: Drifts the background as the page scrolls, behind the content, as a percentage of the section's height. 0 is off — the right starting point, because a pattern moving too fast pulls the eye away from the copy. 6 is subtle, 10 medium, 16 strong, and anything in between is allowed. 40 is the ceiling; the page stops there.

section_bg_px_dir.label: Background movement direction
section_bg_px_dir.doc: Which way the background travels as the page scrolls. Only matters once movement above is above 0. Neighboring sections set in opposite directions are what reads as depth rather than as one sheet sliding.

section_bg_mobile.label: Section background — phones
section_bg_mobile.doc: Optional. A version of the background for phones, used below 768px wide. Leave it empty and the main background above is used at every size. Worth setting when the main artwork is wide: cropped to a narrow screen it often shows nothing recognizable, and a tall or simplified version reads far better.
